title: R&M active patrol/security clients, wave 2 (DART pest-control project, private-client umbrella, small forestry properties)
provider_modules_basis: No new provider-level module enablement in this wave.
notes: Continues rm_active_clients_wave1_2026-09-22. Every organization/site/zone here is backed by REAL R&M patrol-log spreadsheet data, not invented.

DART / 'Operation Lizard' site coordinates were given directly as exact NZTM2000 (EPSG:2193) grid references in R&M's own file, converted to WGS84 via Snyder's Transverse Mercator inverse formulas with LINZ's published NZTM2000 parameters (not text geocoding) — the most precise data of any client seeded so far. Only ACTIVE sites with usable coordinates were placed; deactivated sites (6, 8, 9, 10, 11) and sites with incomplete coordinates (2B, 3A, 7A) were excluded rather than guessed.

OtherPrivate/PVT is a genuine grouped bucket of unrelated private individuals sharing one R&M billing file — modelled as ONE umbrella organization with one client_sites row per distinct contact/property. Birdhurst's duplicate rows in this file were excluded (Birdhurst already has its own dedicated organization from wave 1) and R&M's own internal 'Admin/BASE' row was excluded (not an external client).

Private - Parks and Private - Redvale - Merc are small standalone forestry/property clients confirmed via their own List-sheet GL codes (not tied to any existing org). Cycle Trails, Digger work, and OFO Culling REMSEC project logs were checked and confirmed to be activity tied to already-seeded TPFL/OFO (their DATA/Summary sheets show 'Company'/'Sum of ... TPFL'/'OFO Forest Protection' directly) — no new organizations created for those three.
